stories.title: Fmi rivede al rialzo Pil Italia, +0.8% nel 2026 e inflazione al 3,3%

en.title: IMF revises up Italy's GDP, +0.8% in 2026 and inflation at 3.3%
en.summary: The IMF projects Italy's economic growth at 0.8% for 2026 with inflation at 3.3%, while eurozone growth is expected to slow to 1.1% this year. China's growth is forecast at 4.5% in 2026 and 4% in 2027.

stories.title: Fmi, nel 2026 in Italia inflazione al 3,3%, area euro al 3,1%, Usa al 3,6%

en.title: IMF: Italy inflation at 3.3% in 2026, eurozone at 3.1%, USA at 3.6%
en.summary: The IMF projects inflation rates across major economies for 2026, with Italy at 3.3%, the eurozone at 3.1%, and the USA at 3.6%. Spain is expected to experience higher inflation at 3.7%.

stories.title: Colpiti data center russi, dati anomali anche in Italia: presto per parlare di stop alla propaganda

en.title: Russian data centers hit, anomalous data also in Italy: too early to speak of stopping propaganda
en.summary: Ukrainian raids targeted Russian Yandex data centers, with investigations examining bot activity and systems used to finance disinformation campaigns. Anomalies have been detected in Italy as well.

stories.title: Salvini si dimette da segretario della Lega: "Necessario per ricandidarmi"

en.title: Salvini resigns as Lega secretary: "Necessary to run again"
en.summary: Matteo Salvini has resigned from his position as leader of the Lega party as a formal procedural step required by party rules to allow him to be a candidate at an extraordinary party congress scheduled for October 24-25 in Milan.

stories.title: Sardegna, il salvataggio dello speleologo bloccato in una grotta

en.title: Sardinia, the rescue of the speleologist trapped in a cave
en.summary: A rescue operation took place in Sardinia to save a speleologist who became trapped in a cave.

stories.title: Lega: Salvini si dimette da segretario, passo necessario per ricandidarsi

en.title: Lega: Salvini resigns as secretary, necessary step to run for re-election
en.summary: Matteo Salvini resigned as secretary of the Lega party, a move deemed necessary for his re-candidacy. Di Rubba will serve as commissioner until the party congress.

stories.title: Lega, Salvini si dimette solo per ricandidarsi: “Ora basta divisioni”

en.title: Lega, Salvini resigns only to run again: "Now enough divisions"
en.summary: Salvini resigned from his party leadership position ahead of an October party congress, aiming to secure his reelection. The party plans to eliminate secret voting and change its symbol.

stories.title: La liberazione dello speleologo bloccato in una grotta in Sardegna

en.title: The liberation of the speleologist trapped in a cave in Sardinia
en.summary: Luca Olmetto, 31 years old, was rescued after becoming trapped 10 meters underground when the cave ceiling collapsed in the Gorropeddu area of Sardinia.

stories.title: In un video il momento in cui i soccorritori estraggono lo speleologo bloccato in grotta: l'applauso liberatorio dopo il salvataggio

en.title: Video shows the moment rescuers extract the caver trapped in the cave: liberating applause after the rescue
en.summary: Rescue workers successfully extracted a trapped caver from a cave, with video footage capturing the extraction and the applause from the rescue team.

stories.title: Estratto vivo dopo 27 ore sotto terra: il video del salvataggio dello speleologo

en.title: Rescued alive after 27 hours underground: video of the caver's rescue
en.summary: A 31-year-old caver was pulled alive from a cave in Sardinia after 27 hours trapped under rocks and debris at 10 meters depth. Alpine and fire rescue teams successfully completed the extraction operation.

stories.title: Estratto vivo dopo più di 26 ore lo speleologo bloccato in una grotta in Ogliastra / Il video

en.title: Caver rescued alive after more than 26 hours trapped in a cave in Ogliastra / Video
en.summary: Rescue teams in Sardinia mobilized to help a 31-year-old caver after a cave ceiling collapse. The successful rescue drew relief and encouragement from those present.

stories.title: Kiev attacca i data center russi. Zelensky: “Da quando è colpita Yandex, online si respira di più”

en.title: Kyiv attacks Russian data centers. Zelensky: "Since Yandex was hit, there's more breathing room online"
en.summary: Ukraine targeted Russian data centers, with Zelensky claiming improved online conditions following strikes against Yandex. The Kremlin stated Putin would only consider a ceasefire on Ukraine's election day.

stories.title: Porta a porta, 9 lavoratori su 10 lo scelgono per la flessibilità

en.title: Door-to-door sales, 9 out of 10 workers choose it for flexibility
en.summary: A new survey found that most door-to-door sales workers value the flexibility of the job, with a majority satisfied with their earnings. Most use it as supplementary income, while younger workers are attracted to training opportunities.

stories.title: Contratto bancari, incontro su welfare e benessere organizzativo

en.title: Banking contract, meeting on welfare and organizational well-being
en.summary: Negotiations resumed between the Italian Bankers Association and unions today regarding renewal of the banking labor contract, which expired on March 31.

stories.title: Granarolo, finanziamento da 450 milioni legato a obiettivi di sostenibilità

en.title: Granarolo, 450 million financing linked to sustainability objectives
en.summary: Granarolo secured 450 million euros in financing tied to sustainability goals to support its next growth phase. The dairy company aims to strengthen its existing operations across Italy and international markets following its expansion years.

stories.title: Assemblea di Assolombarda, le interviste agli imprenditori

en.title: Assolombarda Assembly, interviews with entrepreneurs
en.summary: Interviews were conducted with several key figures present at Assolombarda's assembly held in Milan.

stories.title: Crociere, crescono i passeggeri in Italia: previsto un +4,3% sul 2025

en.title: Cruises, passenger numbers growing in Italy: +4.3% expected in 2025
en.summary: Italy is projected to handle 15.4 million cruise passengers in 2026, representing a 4.3% increase from 2025, with over 6,000 port calls expected, up 6.6% year-over-year.
